text: Make a silent 9-second widescreen Voyager 1 fact clip using https://science.nasa.gov/mission/voyager/voyager-1/ with three equal scenes labeled 'Launched: September 5, 1977', 'Jupiter flyby: 1979', and 'Saturn flyby: 1980'; keep 'Voyager 1' and 'Source: NASA Science' visible throughout. Quick pls.
withheld: Show the probe near Earth, then Jupiter, then Saturn.
